name: Radix Tale
storyline:
Your character's story takes place in the world of Radix Tale, a magical world full of adventures.

Users can choose from several character types to train and, over time, become increasingly stronger. As their strength or powers increase, they can face increasingly dangerous adventures and explore places with increasingly powerful enemies.
summary: Radix Tale is a free-to-play, old-school Medieval Fantasy MMORPG with original features and entirely in Portuguese.
